abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: While this unit is within range of an objective, add 1 to its Leadership.

abilities.name: Braced Firing
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, if this unit Remained Stationary this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

abilities.name: Rally Call
abilities.text: Once per battle, a friendly unit nearby may ignore a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Steady Orders
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Quartermaster
abilities.text: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Steady Gait
abilities.text: This model can shoot even if it Fell Back this turn.

abilities.name: Armoured Hull
abilities.text: Each time an attack targets this model, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rules.name: Drilled Volleys
rules.text: Each time a model in a unit from your army makes a ranged attack, if that unit remained stationary this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Focused Fire
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that has not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.text:
When: Your Shooting phase.
Target: One unit from your army that has not shot this phase.
Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Brace Lines
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit picks its targets.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that was picked as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.text:
When: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit picks its targets.
Target: One unit from your army that was picked as a target.
Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Hold the Gate
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that has not fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
stratagems.text:
When: The Fight phase.
Target: One unit from your army that has not fought this phase.
Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Endless Tide
abilities.text: Each Command phase, return one destroyed model to this unit.

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 5+
abilities.text: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+ it does not.

abilities.name: Smouldering Ward
abilities.text: While a friendly Ashen Host unit is within 6" of this model, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Kindle the Pyre
abilities.text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Burning Bulk
abilities.text: After this model ends a Charge move, roll a D6 for each enemy unit nearby.

abilities.name: Searing Grip
abilities.text: Each time this model makes an attack, re-roll a Damage roll of 1.

abilities.name: Molten Plating
abilities.text: Attacks with AP -1 against this model are treated as AP 0.

abilities.name: Fused Plates
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack targets this model, add 1 to the saving throw.

rules.name: Burning Zeal
rules.text: Each time a model in a unit from your army makes a melee attack, if that unit made a charge move this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Fan the Flames
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that has not shot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, that attack has the [Lethal Hits] ability.
stratagems.text:
When: Your Shooting phase.
Target: One unit from your army that has not shot this phase.
Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, that attack has the [Lethal Hits] ability.
